column1: # Deutsches Afrika Korps\PG2 DAK Readme.txt · 译文填写表：只改第三列（译文），其余别动

column2: Congratulations for your designation as new commander in chief of our expeditionary forces in Africa. Your mission is to aid our Italian partners in their fight against the British, after a bad year of defeats for our allies in Africa.
column3: 祝贺你被任命为我们非洲远征军的新任总司令。你的任务是在我们的盟军经历了一年失败之后，协助我们的意大利伙伴对抗英军。

column2: The Italians have lost the most of his territories in Africa, and we cannot allow the British to get the whole control of this continent, otherwise, the Mediterranean Sea would be completely under the enemy management.
column3: 意大利人在非洲已经失去了大部分领土，我们不能允许英国人取得整个大陆的控制权，否则地中海将完全落入敌人的掌控。

column2: The OKH knows that you will be able to stop the enemy, and defeat his plans. For this purpose, we will put under your command the 15 Panzer Division, and the 5 Leichte Division, however, depending from your success, more reinforcements would be sent to you.
column3: OKH 知道你有能力阻止敌人，粉碎他的计划。为此，我们将把第15装甲师和第5轻装师交给你指挥，不过，随着你的战果，会有更多补充兵员派给你。

column2: As soon as you arrive to Africa, you will feel that the environment is completely different from the Polish or French soil, where you have taken actions until now. The terrain there, is desertical, with extremely hot days, and icy nights. The roads are mainly sand stripes made by the wheels of the trucks, drawed between the dunes. The fuel and the water are precious goods, and basically the life is hard in the deserts of North Africa.
column3: 一旦你抵达非洲，你就会感觉到这里的环境与迄今为止你作战过的波兰或法国土地完全不同。那里的地形是沙漠，白天酷热，夜晚冰冷。道路主要是卡车车轮在沙丘之间碾出的沙带。燃料和水都是珍贵的物资，基本上，北非沙漠里的生活很艰苦。

column2: In the other hand, the enemy forces consist mainly of elements from the 8th British Army. Some of the enemy units are the finest of all the British Armies, like the 7th Armoured Division (Desert Rats). The British surely will outnumber our units, but our equipment is better, at least we think that.
column3: 另一方面，敌方部队主要由英国第8集团军的部队组成。其中一些敌方单位是英军中最精锐的，例如第7装甲师（沙漠之鼠）。英军的人数肯定超过我们的单位，但我们的装备更好，至少我们是这样认为的。

column2: This campaign shows historically all the DAK actions in North Africa, from the arrive of Rommel to Tripoli, until the battles at El Alamein. It also shows the desert conditions in the battles, the lack of supplies and the lack of fuel. We won't be able to replace all the losses of our units, and the enema air force has a complete air superiority… Basically the conditions in the desert are HARD.
column3: 本战役如实展现了德意志非洲军团在北非的全部行动，从 Rommel 抵达 Tripoli 起，直到 El Alamein 的战役。它也展现了战役中的沙漠条件、补给短缺与燃料短缺。我们无法补充单位损失的全部兵员，而敌方空军拥有完全的空中优势……基本上，沙漠中的条件很艰苦。

column2: You will fight from 1941 until the important battles at El Alamein. After that… only you know where the DAK will go.
column3: 你将自1941年一直战斗到 El Alamein 的重要战役。在那之后……只有你知道德意志非洲军团会去向何方。
